During a scheduled tick, use the current discovery and its selected roots to
match the pending reply to an exact selected conversation before any deep mail
read. An email address alone cannot identify the conversation. If the item
is outside selection or lacks an unambiguous match, report it
as deferred for this tick and continue with the next item. Leave its campaign
state as it stands. A search or history lookup cannot supply that initial match.
